name: nGZDrawSoftRender::cSpanRender8::vf5 (the texture slot: spans of a texture, by its format, colour key and mode)
notes: Mutants (tools/mutate.py, 25 over the source decoders, the modulate, every destination format's encode / lerp / premultiplied, the key test, the scaled and tiled stepping and the mode pick): 24 killed; one equivalent (Dest8::Premultiplied's `v < 0xff` to `<=`: 0xff either way). Lane NW (rendering R5b step 1). Ours is cSpanRender8::DrawTexture, which runs DrawTextureSpans(DestPixel::Palette8, ...) (src/gz/nGZDrawSoftTexture.cpp), one template per destination format for the ~180 span functions the original picks from its table. Difftest GZSpanTexture_Cells (tests/gz_span_texture.cpp): every source format x key x mode (0..14) through the original slot and ours, 256 trials a cell with every colour alpha, destination rows compared byte by byte (padding included); GZSpanTexture_Exhaustive: every 16-bit texel. Only cGZDrawContextRenderToBuffer::SetTarget makes span renderers, and ours makes ours, so the original slot is in effect through callers (its one reference is the vtable). The 909 table functions it picks from (0x8c9ce0..0x909e70; the five tables at 0xe4f580 4444, 0xe4f948 1555, 0xe4fd08 565, 0xe50418 8, 0xe500b8 8888 with 14 rows of 15 words, each table read once, here) have no status entries: their only references are those .rdata words, dead with this slot, but callers.py cannot tie a data table to the hook that kills its reader (the trap must name exactly the hooks the check rests on, and it finds none), so an entry scheme for them is open (docs/subsystems/rendering.md).
